A bride vanishes without a trace. A remote village is gripped by fear. And a terrifying legend begins to feel all too real.
When Purva investigates a mysterious disappearance in a village haunted by the legend of the Yeti, she uncovers a disturbing trail of missing women and a sinister conspiracy lurking beneath the surface. But the closer she gets to the truth, the more blurred the line between myth and reality becomes.
Is the Yeti just a legend, or is something far more terrifying hiding in the shadows? 
Watch this gripping tale of mystery, suspense, and chilling secrets as the truth unfolds!
